{07 00 00}Hey there, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 1b 00}How's it going?{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}Listen, do you maybe
remember that itty-bitty
favor I asked you to do?
{01 08 00}{07 05 00}WHY DIDN'T YOU DO IT?!
Was it really asking too
much?{01 00 00 0f 00}
Do you even realize how
dumb this makes me look,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
{07 15 00}Look, just forget it! 
Give me back my package,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere siin, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 1b 00}Kuidas läheb?{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}Kuula, kas sa mäletad
seda tibatillukest teenet,
mida ma palusin?
{01 08 00}{07 05 00}MIKS SA SEDA EI TEINUD?!
Kas see oli tõesti liiga
palju palutud?{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kas sa üldse taipad, kui
rumalana see mind näitab,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
{07 15 00}Kuule, unusta ära!
Anna mu pakk tagasi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
